purpose: Provide reusable credential and session-token primitives before implementing auth/session services and routes.
success_outcome: FT-001 services can issue and verify local credentials and sessions without leaking or persisting raw auth material.

commands: Check changed code preserves linked Foundation Runtime Substrate, Foundation Data Substrate, Foundation Smoke API when relevant, and Evidence Redaction contracts or records a blocker.
Check pyproject.toml includes argon2-cffi as the password hashing dependency required by FT-001.
Check password hashing produces Argon2id PHC strings with FT-001 parameters and rejects wrong passwords without plaintext persistence.
Check session token tests prove at least 256-bit entropy generation, SHA-256 token_hash-only persistence, malformed-token rejection, and constant-time digest comparison.
Check auth/session redaction covers passwords, raw tokens, token hashes, cookies, bearer tokens, and auth headers per Evidence Redaction and API Guidelines.
success_checks: Password hashing uses argon2-cffi Argon2id PHC strings with FT-001 parameters and verification is one-way without storing plaintext passwords.
Opaque session tokens use at least 256 bits of entropy from Python secrets APIs and are returned only through the selected session transport.
LocalSession token storage persists only lowercase hex SHA-256 token_hash values and verifies presented tokens with constant-time digest comparison.
Redaction covers passwords, tokens, token hashes, cookies, bearer tokens, and auth headers in error/log-like strings.
T3 closure includes /verify PASS, /red-verify semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, and ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present.
evidence_required: dependency diff showing argon2-cffi added to runtime dependencies
session token entropy, SHA-256 token_hash-only persistence, and constant-time comparison evidence
sample redaction evidence for auth/session material

stop_conditions: A required test would expose real or generated secrets unredacted.
A password hashing implementation does not use argon2-cffi Argon2id with the FT-001 parameter contract.
A primitive requires storing raw session tokens.
Token verification cannot be proven constant-time at the digest comparison boundary.
Security behavior conflicts with FT-001 or API Guidelines.
Implementation contradicts verified FT-000 app/settings/database/session/redaction baseline.
